condition_note: Intact southwest quarter sheet, with large sea area retained. Use its own printed graticule and inner frame.
line_slope_bounds_reason: Preview meridians are nearly vertical; measure native inclinations within these bounds.

printed_longitude_note.transcription: All Longitudes require a correction of -1′-9″ to reduce them to the origin of the Great Trigonometrical Survey: viz: the Madras Observatory taken as 80°17′21″, and a further correction of -3′1″.5, to reduce them to the latest value 80°14′19″.5, of that Observatory.

longitude_convention_status: The sheet explicitly prints two corrections: -69″ and -181.5″ (total -250.5″). The user-selected working adjustment remains -216.18″, 34.32″ east of that printed total; modern datum alignment remains provisional.
longitude_correction_basis: Printed margin confirms -69 arcseconds Atlas to old GTS and states a further -181.5 arcseconds to Madras 80d14m19.5s. Retain user-selected working second correction -147.18 arcseconds, total -216.18; this differs from printed total -250.5 by +34.32 arcseconds. Modern datum alignment remains provisional.
frame_stroke_width_reason: Native northeast crop review shows coastal shading touching the east inner frame and enlarging its apparent thickness. Cap inward stroke extension before the four-pixel inset.
